pages.title: About — Bloom Creative Studio
pages.description: Meet the team behind Bloom Creative Studio. A small, focused team of photographers and designers in Austin, TX.

props.heading: About Bloom
props.story:
Bloom Creative Studio was founded in 2018 by Natalie Reeves, a photographer and interior designer who saw the gap between how spaces look and how they feel.

Our small team of four brings together editorial photography, residential interiors, and brand strategy under one roof. We work slowly and intentionally — typically taking on 3–4 projects at a time so every client gets our full attention.

We're based in East Austin's creative district, surrounded by the makers, chefs, and entrepreneurs who inspire our work. Most of our clients come through referrals, which tells us we're doing something right.
props.mission: To create visual experiences that feel as good as they look — spaces you want to live in and images you want to keep.
